parameters.query: INSERT INTO personal_daily_tasks (user_id, chat_id, task_date, content, priority) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id, task_date, content, priority, status

SELECT id, task_date, content, priority, status FROM personal_daily_tasks WHERE user_id = $1 AND task_date = $2 ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, status DESC, id ASC LIMIT 50
INSERT INTO personal_daily_tasks (user_id, chat_id, task_date, content, priority) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id, task_date, content, priority, status

UPDATE personal_daily_tasks SET content = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), content), priority = CASE WHEN $4 IN ('HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW') THEN $4 ELSE priority END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2 RETURNING id, content, priority, task_date, status
UPDATE personal_daily_tasks SET status = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2 RETURNING id, content, task_date, status
DELETE FROM personal_daily_tasks WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2 RETURNING id
DELETE FROM personal_daily_tasks WHERE user_id = $1 AND ($2 = '' OR task_date = $2) RETURNING id
